# R6.29 — FP continuation rules + holds (manifest 283)

Spec §10.1.4's first-pass runner rules made mechanical and
fixture-verified, reading cost and infrastructure fields only.
USD $0.00, offline only — **machinery, not execution**: values fill
at FP-E (R6.46); the rules run in W4 (R6.47); the `w4-lane-probe`
leg is registered, never run.

## What landed

**Stage 1 — FP runner rules** (`crates/hh-runner/src/continuation.rs`):

- `hh-fp-continuation-input/1` strict decode — any outcome member
  refuses typed `refused{outcome_field}` (X-07 firewall).
- The one projection formula `p̂_h = 1.2 × max(1.5 × mean, P90)` over
  ≥ 10 measured else the binding prior; the step-fit test against
  `root − consumed − Σ orphans@bounded.hi − C × s`; `t̂_h = 1.1 ×
  mean` (≥ 3) else the 1,040 s prior, native lane on mini's t̂.
- The automatic round-boundary checkpoint — drops in the declared
  priority order (Q-X61 parameter: V5 → Claude Code → Pi; protected
  pair last, then every slot + P2-FP/P3-L2/P4-FP typed refusals);
  `hh-fp-checkpoint/1` cost-only readout + REQ-XC-322 p99 report;
  every drop labelled "cost-triggered; cost correlates with failure
  length".
- Per-arm µ$ caps (planned × p̂) with expected-cost slot admission —
  `withheld{budget}` on breach, slice against the root only, capped
  cost a `censored_lower_bound`, the family member retained
  unavailable.
- Wall time — `W_p` with retry allowance + load; `d_max` over R6.14
  ceilings (billed else ceiling; unauthorized Wc → overflow
  reservation only); pair-atomic `withheld{window_deadline}`.
- §6.6 stop rules: budget / infra / integrity / calendar only, no
  outcome trigger; partial rows retained.

**Stage 2 — FP holds** (`crates/hh-runner/src/holds.rs`):

- Fallback — the Q-X62 trigger record (days from the record, decided
  at FP-S) or a G-L1 both-partition failure → hosted-only W4 arms +
  `withheld{l1_not_passed}` for P3-L2 and P4-FP, citing the trigger.
- Lane probe — ≤ $0.05 driver (one receipted call per pinned effort
  path over `ProbeTransport`), `hh-lane-probe/1`; a failed probe or
  ≥ 1 infra of the first 3 slots →
  `withheld{admission:native_lane_hold}`; repair = new H → new G-L1.
  The `w4-lane-probe` leg is registered in `scripts/live-verify.sh`.
- PP0 holds — detection from infra members + AG3/AG5/AG6/AG8 only
  (a verdict refuses typed); dispositions (a) held arm
  `withheld{admission:AG<n>|pp0_infra_hold}` drops from FP-E with the
  family retained unavailable, (b) held mini →
  `hh-fp-scope-decision/1` default `end_pass_after_w2` with all four
  claims withheld, (c) adjacent-cell replacement + disclosure flag.
